facts.fact: The Chambre des comptes audit says Huawei has supplied and maintained state operator Camtel's information systems since 2011, directly manages the equipment and holds the access codes without a written agreement or real Camtel control.
The Chambre des comptes audit of Camtel says three submarine cables, WACS, NCSCS and SAIL (to Brazil), have been in service since 2015, with utilisation of 18.5%, 1.25% and 0.31% at end-2021.
facts.system: WACS, NCSCS and SAIL submarine cables

systems.system: WACS, NCSCS and SAIL submarine cables

CMR.note: The document states nothing on satellite broadband.
